from pathlib import Path
from array import array
import struct,math,json,hashlib,time
B=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;D=B/'wmma-dot-float-test-r1'
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'));sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for r in read(D/'capture-manifest.json'):assert (D/r['name']).stat().st_size==r['bytes'] and sha(D/r['name'])==r['sha256']
def words(name,code):
    a=array(code);a.frombytes((D/name).read_bytes());return a
left,right=words('left-half.bin','H'),words('right-half.bin','H')
initial,trace,host_model=words('carry.bin','I'),words('prefix.bin','I'),words('model-prefix.bin','I')
wmma,bf=words('wmma-fp16.bin','I'),words('wmma-bf16.bin','I')
def bits(x):return struct.unpack('<I',struct.pack('<f',x))[0]
def value(x):return struct.unpack('<f',struct.pack('<I',x))[0]
def half(h):
    e=(h>>10)&31;m=h&1023
    return math.ldexp((1024+m) if e else m,e-25 if e else -24)*(-1 if h&0x8000 else 1)
def half_e(h):
    e=(h>>10)&31;m=h&1023
    return e-15 if e else m.bit_length()-25 if m else -126
def predict(a,b,c):
    exps=[half_e(a[i])+half_e(b[i]) if (a[i]&0x7fff) and (b[i]&0x7fff) else -126 for i in range(2)]
    ce=((bits(c)>>23)&255)-127 if c else -126;e=max(*exps,ce-2);q=math.ldexp(1.0,e-24)
    neg=[bool((a[i]^b[i])&0x8000) for i in range(2)];p=[half(a[i])*half(b[i]) for i in range(2)]
    total=math.trunc(c/q)+(2 if c<0 else 0)
    for v,n in zip(p,neg):total+=-(math.trunc(abs(v)/q)+1) if n else math.trunc(abs(v)/q)
    raw=bits(total*q);raw=0 if not (raw&0x7fffffff) else raw
    return raw,dict(product_exponents=exps,carry_exponent=ce,E=e,q=q,products=p,negative_products=neg,carry_q=c/q)
started=time.monotonic();out=[]
reports=read(D/'reports.json');assert len(reports)==8
for family in range(8):
    bad=recursive_bad=cpu_host_bad=wmma_bad=bf_bad=0;strata={};examples=[]
    for cell in range(family*16384,(family+1)*16384):
        tile,pos=divmod(cell,256);row,col=divmod(pos,16)
        a=left[tile*256+row*16:tile*256+row*16+16];b=right[tile*256+col*16:tile*256+col*16+16];c_model=value(initial[cell])
        for step in range(8):
            index=cell*8+step;c=value(trace[index-1] if step else initial[cell])
            raw,context=predict(a[step*2:step*2+2],b[step*2:step*2+2],c)
            rec,_=predict(a[step*2:step*2+2],b[step*2:step*2+2],c_model);c_model=value(rec)
            recursive_bad+=rec!=trace[index];cpu_host_bad+=rec!=host_model[index]
            if raw!=trace[index]:
                bad+=1;label=f"negativeC={int(c<0)},negP={sum(context['negative_products'])},ep-ec={max(context['product_exponents'])-context['carry_exponent']}";strata[label]=strata.get(label,0)+1
                if len(examples)<5:examples.append(dict(cell=cell,step=step,a=list(a[step*2:step*2+2]),b=list(b[step*2:step*2+2]),carry=c,carry_bits=bits(c),actual=value(trace[index]),actual_bits=trace[index],predicted=value(raw),prediction_bits=raw,**context))
        wmma_bad+=wmma[cell]!=trace[cell*8+7]
        if family<6:bf_bad+=bf[cell]!=trace[cell*8+7]
    native=reports[family];assert native['family']==family and native['actual_prefix_model_mismatches']==bad and native['recursive_model_mismatches']==recursive_bad and native['fp16_wmma_dot2_mismatches']==wmma_bad and native['bf16_wmma_dot2_mismatches']==bf_bad and cpu_host_bad==0
    record=dict(family=family,cells=16384,actual_prefix_model_mismatches=bad,recursive_model_mismatches=recursive_bad,independent_cpu_model_bit_mismatches=cpu_host_bad,fp16_wmma_dot2_mismatches=wmma_bad,bf16_checked=family<6,bf16_wmma_dot2_mismatches=bf_bad,mismatch_strata=strata,examples=examples);out.append(record)
    print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
record=dict(kind='independent_wmma_dot_float_analysis',families=out,prefix_states=1048576,fp16_wmma_cells=131072,bf16_wmma_cells=98304,script_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)),capture_manifest_sha256=sha(D/'capture-manifest.json'),wall_seconds=time.monotonic()-started,general_model_proven=False)
with (B/'wmma-dot-float-analysis-r1.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(record,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
